sources.entry: indico - Feature-rich event management system, made @ CERN, the place where the Web was born. (Demo, Source Code) MIT Python

summary.one_liner: Indico is a web-based, feature-rich, plugin-extensible event management system made at CERN, covering conferences, meetings, registration, and room booking.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Indico as a general-purpose event management tool with hierarchical content management for events. It includes a conference workflow with Call for Abstracts and abstract reviewing modules, configurable registration forms, integration with payment systems, and a paper reviewing workflow. It also provides a drag-and-drop timetable interface, a badge editor for printing badges and tickets, and tools for meeting management and archival of presentation materials. A room booking interface and integration with video conferencing solutions are listed as well. Extensibility is through plugins.
use_cases: organize a conference with abstract submission and review
manage event registration forms and payments
build an event timetable with drag and drop
print badges and tickets for participants
connect events to video conferencing tools
notable: Call for Abstracts and abstract reviewing modules
caveats: Browser support limited to minimum versions listed (e.g., Firefox 127+, Chrome 125+, Safari 17.4+, Edge 125+)
Installation requires following guides in the project's external documentation; no setup commands in the README
